planets.name: WASP-10 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-10 with a 3.09-day year, found in 2008.

text.card: WASP-10 b was found in 2008 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-10. Its orbit and size follow Johnson et al. 2009's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname JOHNSON_ET_AL__2009): disc_year 2008, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.09272826, pl_radj 1.08, pl_bmassj 3.15

quotes.title: WASP-10b
quotes.card: WASP-10b is an extrasolar planet discovered in 2008 by SuperWASP using the transit method.
quotes.introduction: It takes about three days to orbit around WASP-10.
